meta.parties: Elaine Muthumani v. Muthumani Et Al

rules.statement: The Court should accept a higher offer for property sold on behalf of minors if it is deemed just and reasonable, even if the sale was initially confirmed by a Commissioner.
rules.supporting_quote: "Having given my best consideration to the facts of the case, I have come to the conclusion that it is just and reasonable that the 1st respondent's offer should be accepted."
